regime_context: The leading theme (Memory/HBM) sits on fragile ground: low durability, zero breadth, 'fading' val-state, while eligible via the absolute-trend gate. The broad rotation (72% eligible) and moderate absorption (0.34) suggest no single narrative dominates. The trend gate has historically cut drawdowns in this market, but thematic momentum ranks are confirmed rank-IC ~0 — a focus lens only. Track record is poor (dir accuracy 17%); size and de-risk accordingly.

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage

theses.dissent: Breadth of 0.0, mixed Hurst, and durability of 0.44 signal a fragile top that could reverse sharply without warning; the fading val-state underscores this risk.
